Static HTML preview uses HtmlSanitizer 9.2.1039 by Michael Ganss,
AngleSharp 1.7.2 and AngleSharp.Css 1.0.2 by the AngleSharp contributors.
All three are MIT licensed; complete licenses accompany this notice.
Exact source revisions and runtime/source hashes are in runtime-manifest.json.
The release dependency-source archive includes each complete pinned source tree.
These parsers run without a network loader or script engine, before WebView2 sees
the sanitized document and CSS. Remote resource URLs and active content are
removed; Pathweft separately restricts WebView2 navigation, resources and bridges.
